headline: New Development Bank allocates $300 million to develop low-carbon energy in Uzbekistan
summary: The BRICS New Development Bank will provide a $300 million loan to Uzbekistan for low-carbon energy. The funds will go to solar, wind, hydro and nuclear power projects.
why: The New Development Bank is a multilateral lender founded by the BRICS countries to finance infrastructure and sustainable development projects. Its loans shape energy investment in emerging markets.
original_headline: Yangi taraqqiyot banki O‘zbekistonga past uglerodli energetikani rivojlantirish uchun 300 mln dollar ajratadi
